questions.stem: In a plane electromagnetic wave, the electric field oscillates sinusoidally with a frequency of $2 \times 10^{18}\text{ Hz}$ and amplitude 48 V/m.

sub_parts.a: What is the wavelength of the emf wave?
sub_parts.b: Calculate the amplitude of the oscillating magnetic field.
sub_parts.c: Calculate average energy density of the electromagnetic field at the wave
